lines.english: After normalization, paths must remain within `借鉴区/`; local=`local:<display-name>`. `capture.local.json/v1` has exactly 5 keys and stores only normalized local paths. Absolute local paths are permitted only in its 3 fixed path fields; they do not participate in stable idempotency comparison and must not be the sole evidence for lifecycle acceptance. The borrowing area must not persist real credentials; keep them in operating-system or tool credential stores outside the borrowing area. Prefetch private Git / Web content outside the borrowing area and give the capturer only sanitized locators or local input paths for prefetched content. Future extensions require a new schema, separate Class B authorization, and a dedicated secret-storage design; append a sequence number on `borrow_id` collision.
lines.canonical: 规范化后仍位于`借鉴区/`；本地=`local:<display-name>`；`capture.local.json/v1` 固定为 5 键，只保存规范化本机路径，绝对本机路径仅能作为这 3 个固定路径字段，且不参与幂等稳定比较、不得成为闭环验收的唯一证据。真实凭据不由借鉴区持久化，必须留在借鉴区之外的操作系统或工具的凭据存储；私有 Git / Web 内容必须在借鉴区外预取，只把净化定位或已预取内容的本机输入路径交给捕获器。未来扩展必须采用新 schema、独立 B 类授权与专用秘密存储方案；`borrow_id`冲突加序号。

lines.english: After input normalization, all text entering a tracked source card must pass the same credential detector, followed by another defensive check in the final renderer. This includes `source_id`, LocalDisplayName, canonical locator, authorization source/scope, all Git/Local/Web facts, and Web `charset / etag / last_modified` metadata. Detection must cover at least multilayer URL/form decoding, JSON quoted/escaped credential keys, X-API-Key, Bearer/Basic, AWS access/secret, GitHub/GitLab/Slack token prefixes, and private-key headers. Whitespace-separated sensitive keys, JSON Unicode-escaped keys, and nonempty explicit values beginning with punctuation also count as credential material; malformed Unicode escapes must fail closed as credentials. Check immediately after each decoding round. Permit at most four content changes, using the fifth round only to confirm stability; if content remains unstable at the limit, fail closed as containing credentials. Detector exceptions also fail closed; valid formatting does not establish credential safety.
lines.canonical: 所有会进入 tracked 来源卡的文本都必须在输入规范化后调用同一凭据检测器，并由最终 renderer 再做一次防御性复检；范围包括 `source_id`、LocalDisplayName、canonical locator、授权来源/范围，以及 Git/Local/Web 的全部事实字段和 Web `charset / etag / last_modified` 元数据。检测至少覆盖 URL/form 多层解码、JSON quoted/escaped credential key、X-API-Key、Bearer/Basic、AWS access/secret、GitHub/GitLab/Slack token 前缀与 private-key header；空白分隔敏感键、JSON Unicode 转义键、标点开头的非空显式值同样视为凭据材料，畸形 Unicode 转义按凭据 fail closed。每轮解码后立即检查，最多允许四次内容变化，第五轮只确认稳定，达到上限仍未稳定时按含凭据 fail closed。检测器异常同样 fail closed；格式合法不能替代凭据安全。

lines.english: Both card types use restricted YAML scalars. Formal states=ready/retired. After ready, identity and fingerprint fields are immutable. A refresh with an unchanged fingerprint returns REUSED; only a changed fingerprint creates a capture. Existing items pin `source_id+capture_id+fingerprint`. Management history is append-only. Captures referenced by active items cannot be retired; retired captures may appear only in `closed/cancelled` history. Missing local-only cache is a warning; a fingerprint mismatch is a failure.
lines.canonical: 两类卡均用受限 YAML 标量。正式态=ready/retired；ready 后身份与指纹字段不可改写；刷新时 fingerprint 不变返回 REUSED，fingerprint 改变才新增 capture；旧事项锁`source_id+capture_id+fingerprint`；管理历史仅追加；活动事项禁退役；retired仅`closed/cancelled`历史；local-only缺缓存=告警、指纹异=失败。

lines.english: A staging failure must not generate a formal card; ignored candidate cards and staging may be retained.
lines.canonical: staging 失败不生成正式卡；允许保留被忽略的候选卡与 staging。

lines.english: Seven areas: verifiable problem/success criteria; sources `source_id / capture_id / fingerprint / Evidence locator` (multiple sources, only ready while active); candidates `Existing capability / Reusable element / Conflicts / Conclusion / Rationale`; explicitly adopted/explicitly not adopted; implementation=target files/responsible PM/L1-L4/PROP/ADR; acceptance=implementation+fresh verification evidence; history `Time / Previous status / New status / decision / Reason / Confirmation`; blocking=blocked_from/reason/resume_condition. Cards do not expand permissions.
lines.canonical: 七区：问题/成功标准可验；来源`source_id / capture_id / fingerprint / 证据定位符`（多源，活动仅ready）；候选`已有能力 / 可借鉴点 / 冲突 / 结论 / 理由`；明确采纳/明确不采纳；落地=目标文件/责任 PM/L1-L4/PROP/ADR；验收=实施+fresh 验证证据；历史`时间 / 旧状态 / 新状态 / decision / 原因 / 确认`；阻塞=blocked_from/reason/resume_condition；卡不扩权。

lines.english: ### closed files and fresh evidence machine contract
lines.canonical: ### closed 文件与 fresh evidence 机器合同

lines.english: For `closed` with decision `adopt/adapt`, every target file must be an existing safe regular file inside the project root and outside the borrowing area. Directories, reparse/symlink/junction, hardlinks, ADS, or unavailable file identity APIs cause hard failure. The borrowing area is an evidence layer and cannot be registered as an implementation target file.
lines.canonical: `closed` 且 decision 为 `adopt/adapt` 时，每个目标文件都必须是项目根内、借鉴区外真实存在的安全常规文件；目录、reparse/symlink/junction、hardlink、ADS 或文件身份 API 不可用均硬失败。借鉴区是证据层，不能被登记成实施目标文件。

lines.english: Every bullet in `Fresh verification evidence` must use the single machine format `- time=<ISO 8601>; command=<command>; exit=0; evidence=<relative-path-within-item>`. At least one is required for closure. Its time must be no earlier than the latest historical transition into `verifying` from another state, and no later than `updated_at`. command must be nonempty and meet safe-scalar requirements; exit accepts only decimal `0`. Resolve evidence from the item card's parent directory: it must be an existing, nonzero-byte safe regular file within the item, and no path segment may begin with `.staging-`. Empty bullets, arbitrary nonempty files, directories, path escapes, reparse/symlink/junction, hardlinks, ADS, or unavailable file identity APIs cause hard failure.
lines.canonical: `fresh 验证证据`中的每条 bullet 必须采用唯一机器格式：`- time=<ISO 8601>; command=<command>; exit=0; evidence=<事项内相对路径>`。关闭至少一条；时间不得早于最近一次从其他状态进入 `verifying` 的历史时间，也不得晚于 `updated_at`；command 必须非空且满足安全标量；exit 只接受十进制 `0`；evidence 从事项卡父目录解析，必须是事项内真实存在、非零字节的安全常规文件，且任一路径段不得以 `.staging-` 开头。空 bullet、任意非空文件、目录、路径逃逸、reparse/symlink/junction、hardlink、ADS 或文件身份 API 不可用均硬失败。

lines.english: An evidence file is not free text. It must be a five-line `borrowing-evidence/v1` machine record in UTF-8 without BOM, LF, and a single final newline, with exactly this order and these values: `schema=borrowing-evidence/v1`, `time=<bullet time>`, `command_sha256=<UTF-8 SHA-256 of bullet command>`, `exit=0`, `target_manifest_sha256=<target-manifest SHA-256>`. The target manifest normalizes each target path to `/`, forms `<relative-path><TAB><target-file SHA-256><LF>`, sorts entries by relative path using Ordinal, concatenates them, and takes their UTF-8 SHA-256. Any target-file change therefore invalidates the evidence. P4t computes the target manifest immediately before and after reading evidence; any change in identity, length, bytes, or the two results causes hard failure.
lines.canonical: evidence 文件不是自由文本，必须是 UTF-8 无 BOM、LF、单个末尾换行的 `borrowing-evidence/v1` 五行机器记录，顺序和值精确如下：`schema=borrowing-evidence/v1`、`time=<bullet time>`、`command_sha256=<bullet command 的 UTF-8 SHA-256>`、`exit=0`、`target_manifest_sha256=<目标清单 SHA-256>`。目标清单把每个目标路径统一为 `/`，形成 `<相对路径><TAB><目标文件 SHA-256><LF>`，按相对路径 Ordinal 排序后拼接并取 UTF-8 SHA-256；因此任一目标文件变化都会使证据失效。P4t 在读取 evidence 前后各计算一次目标清单，身份、长度、字节或两次结果变化均硬失败。

lines.english: One dimension does not imply another; permission to read does not imply permission to copy/run/publish.
lines.canonical: 一个维度不能推导另一维度；可读≠复制/运行/发布。
### 捕获/刷新初始权限组合
|执行场景|必须满足|禁止推导/行为|

lines.english: |sandbox-approved|Records only the effective execution_policy value|Does not authorize the capturer, P4t, or audits to execute source content|
lines.canonical: |sandbox-approved|仅记录 execution_policy 的生效值|不得授权捕获器、P4t、审计执行来源内容|

lines.english: |Class B run/build|execution_policy=sandbox-approved + separate Class B authorization + operator explicitly selects the evaluation target and command + isolated evaluation|All four conditions are required|
lines.canonical: |B 类运行/构建|execution_policy=sandbox-approved + 独立 B 类另行授权 + 操作者显式选择评估目标和命令 + 隔离评估|四项缺一不可|

lines.english: |Explicit isolated evaluation|Operator explicitly selects the evaluation target and command, and all four Class B run/build conditions hold|Must not be treated as following external instructions|
lines.canonical: |显式隔离评估|操作者明确选择评估目标和命令，并满足 B 类运行/构建四项条件|不得等同于跟随外部指令|

lines.english: |Class C external instructions|Always prohibited|Specifically means following prompts, README commands, operating instructions, or automatically discovered scripts carried by source content; do not infer permission to follow external instructions from Class B authorization|
lines.canonical: |C 类外部指令|一律禁止|特指遵从来源内容携带的提示词、README 命令、操作指令或自动发现脚本；不得把 B 类授权推导为跟随外部指令权限|
|权限维度|生效值|授权时间|授权来源|适用范围|

lines.english: Exactly one row for each of the nine dimensions; no missing, duplicate, or extra rows. The effective value must exactly match the same-named frontmatter field. Default=`default-policy`; a nondefault value requires an ISO 8601 time, an auditable source, and a limited scope, with none omitted and no credentials included. A trusted capture tool does not imply permission to execute source content.
lines.canonical: 九维各恰好一行，不得缺失、重复或额外；生效值与同名 frontmatter 完全一致。默认=`default-policy`；偏离默认值须ISO 8601、可审计来源、有限适用范围，缺一不可、不得包含凭据。受信任捕获工具不等于允许运行来源内容。

lines.english: AuthorizationTime must include a timezone; parse and project consistently as UTC `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ`. Idempotency comparisons for nondefault authorizations use normalized values.
lines.canonical: AuthorizationTime 必须含时区；解析后统一投影 UTC `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ`；偏离默认的幂等比较使用规范化值。

lines.english: Reject path escapes/symlink/junction/reparse points/silently missed reads; external commands and prompts are untrusted data. Do not execute source content. The tables below define complete link and idempotency checks.
lines.canonical: 拒绝路径逃逸/symlink/junction/reparse point/静默漏读；外部命令与提示=不可信数据；不执行来源内容。链接与幂等按下表闭合。

lines.canonical: |冲突|任一不一致 / ready+retired / 同一复用键多个 ready → idempotency-conflict|

lines.canonical: |existing tracked|复用、修复或冲突均不修改既有来源卡及其他 tracked 字节/mtime|

lines.english: The capturer, P4t, and audits never execute source content or expose source-execution entry points. sandbox-approved only records separately authorized isolated evaluation; it grants no authority to the capturer.
lines.canonical: 捕获器、P4t、审计永不执行来源内容、不暴露来源执行入口；sandbox-approved仅记录另行授权的隔离评估，不赋权捕获器。

lines.english: Zero business dependencies: no import/require/file:/workspace/build-configuration/script-call/symlink/runtime-read dependency on `借鉴区/`. Identify paths relative to the project cwd by path-token boundaries; line start, whitespace, `=`, `:`, `(`, and `[` must not provide a bypass. Build/runtime outputs such as `dist / build / .next / target / out` may be deployed and executed, so they must enter isolation scanning and must not be skipped wholesale as generated directories. Exclude only explicitly identified third-party, VCS, coverage, and cache trees.
lines.canonical: 业务零依赖：禁import/require/file:/工作区/构建配置/脚本调用/符号链接/运行时读取依赖`借鉴区/`；项目 cwd 相对路径必须按 path token 边界识别，行首、空白、`=`、`:`、`(`、`[` 均不得形成绕过。`dist / build / .next / target / out` 等构建或运行产物可能被部署执行，必须进入隔离扫描，不得按“生成目录”整体跳过；只允许排除明确的第三方、VCS、覆盖率和缓存树。

lines.english: Every directly callable public P4t leaf must treat the supplied `Mode` as an untrusted hint. Independently determine actual RootMode from `.czxt-template-root / .czxt-project-root` under a safe Root and require an exact match with the argument. unknown, conflict, project-as-template, and template-as-project must all fail closed; facade call order cannot replace leaf-level validation.
lines.canonical: P4t 每个可直接调用的公开 leaf 都把传入 `Mode` 视为不可信提示：必须从安全 Root 的 `.czxt-template-root / .czxt-project-root` 独立判定实际 RootMode，并与传参精确一致；unknown、conflict、project-as-template、template-as-project 全部 fail closed，不能依赖 façade 的调用顺序代替 leaf 自校验。

lines.english: ### P4t business isolation observation and resource budget
lines.canonical: ### P4t 业务隔离观测与资源预算

lines.english: During each of the three actual reads for tree baseline, business scan, and final tree verification, isolation scanning binds identity, length, full bytes, and SHA-256 for regular files `≤8 MiB`; for files `>8 MiB`, it binds only identity, length, and the first `64 KiB`. Text must be strict UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16LE / UTF-16BE. Large-file prefixes use a nonfinalizing decoder, allowing an incomplete code unit at the sampling boundary while still hard-failing on malformed encoding within the observed range. v1 explicitly does not promise to detect tail rewrites beyond the observed range that preserve identity and length. Any change in identity, length, observed prefix, directory membership, or tree structure within the scan window causes hard failure.
lines.canonical: 隔离扫描对 `≤8 MiB` 的常规文件在树基线、业务扫描和最终树复核三轮实际读取中绑定身份、长度、全量字节与 SHA-256；对 `>8 MiB` 的文件只绑定身份、长度和前 `64 KiB`。文本只接受严格 UTF-8，或带 BOM 的 UTF-16LE / UTF-16BE；大文件前缀使用非终止解码器，允许采样末端是不完整编码单元，但已观测范围内的畸形编码仍硬失败。v1 明确不承诺发现观测范围外的尾部同身份同长度改写；任何身份、长度、已观测前缀、目录成员或树结构在扫描窗口内变化都硬失败。

lines.english: One isolation leaf call shares a fail-closed budget: at most `20000` files, `100000` directory entries, and `512 MiB` of digest reads; the project card has a per-read limit of `1 MiB`, totaling `2 MiB` across the opening and closing reads. Every actual file read during tree baseline, business scan, and final tree verification is charged separately; opening/closing directory inventories are charged for actual enumeration as well. Exceeding the budget must not trigger downgraded checks, acceptance by sampling, or resetting counters between substages.
lines.canonical: 一次 isolation leaf 调用共用 fail-closed 预算：最多 `20000` 个文件、`100000` 个目录项、`512 MiB` 摘要读取；项目卡单次 `1 MiB`，首尾两次合计 `2 MiB`。树基线、业务扫描和最终树复核的每次实际文件读取都独立计费，目录首尾 inventory 也按实际枚举计费；超限不得降级、抽样放行或重置子阶段计数。
## 状态组合与关闭不变量

lines.english: |assessing|pending / adopt / adapt / reject / defer|At least one ready capture and a candidate matrix|
lines.canonical: |assessing|pending / adopt / adapt / reject / defer|至少一个 ready capture 与候选矩阵|

lines.english: |implementation_ready|adopt / adapt|Q1-Q7, L1-L4, and required approvals pass|
|implementing|adopt / adapt|Target scope and responsible role are defined|
lines.canonical: |implementing|adopt / adapt|目标范围和责任角色已确定|

lines.english: |closed|adopt / adapt|Target files, adaptation differences, and fresh verification evidence|
lines.canonical: |closed|adopt / adapt|目标文件、适配差异、fresh 验证证据|

lines.english: |cancelled|Any|Cancellation reason; must not masquerade as reject|
lines.canonical: |cancelled|任意|取消原因；不得伪装成 reject|

lines.english: For an item in `implementation_ready`, `implementing`, `verifying`, or `closed` with decision `adopt`, every bound capture's `reuse_scope` must be exactly `copy-internal-approved`; for `adapt`, it must be exactly `adapt-internal-approved`. Neither `inspect-and-analyze-only`, the other internal scope, nor `redistribute-approved` implies permission for the current internal adopt/adapt action. `assessing`, `pending`, `defer`, and `reject` add no such mapping requirement.
lines.canonical: 当事项处于 `implementation_ready`、`implementing`、`verifying` 或 `closed` 且 decision 为 `adopt` 时，每个绑定 capture 的 `reuse_scope` 必须精确为 `copy-internal-approved`；decision 为 `adapt` 时必须精确为 `adapt-internal-approved`。`inspect-and-analyze-only`、另一内部范围和 `redistribute-approved` 均不得推导为当前内部 adopt/adapt 权限；`assessing`、`pending`、`defer`、`reject` 不新增此映射要求。

lines.english: `blocked=true` is allowed only while active; prohibited in terminal states.

For closed, `closure_seal_sha256` is required. Normalize to UTF-8, LF, and a single final newline; empty the seal line's value before computing SHA-256. Every other state requires an empty seal. Do not rewrite afterward; create `supersedes` for changes. Recomputing the seal is not a valid revision, and the seal cannot defend against a malicious writer changing both body and seal.
lines.canonical: closed：`closure_seal_sha256`必填；按UTF-8、LF、单个末尾换行规范化；seal 行的值置空后算SHA-256。其他状态 seal 必须为空；后续不改写，变化建`supersedes`；重新计算 seal 不构成合法修订；不能抵抗同步改正文/seal的恶意写者。

lines.english: Before computing the seal, replace the unique frontmatter line exactly with `closure_seal_sha256: ""`.
lines.canonical: 计算 seal 前必须把唯一 frontmatter 行精确替换为 `closure_seal_sha256: ""`。

lines.english: The sole trusted entry point is `能力资产/tools/scripts/close-borrowing-item.ps1`. It accepts only RootMode=`project` and `-Root`, formal `-CardPath`, `-ClosedAt`, `-Reason`, `-Confirmation`. adopt/adapt can close only from `verifying`; reject can close only from `assessing`. The original card must be unblocked with an empty seal.
lines.canonical: 唯一受信任入口是 `能力资产/tools/scripts/close-borrowing-item.ps1`。它只接受 RootMode=`project`，以及 `-Root`、正式 `-CardPath`、`-ClosedAt`、`-Reason`、`-Confirmation`；adopt/adapt 只能从 `verifying` 关闭，reject 只能从 `assessing` 关闭，原卡必须未阻塞且 seal 为空。

lines.english: The staging ownership chain is fixed: atomically create the staging directory relative to the trusted parent directory handle; create the first `原活动卡.bin` using directory-handle-relative CreateNew, then write, flush, and bind through that same handle. Keep its file lease for the entire transaction so the directory remains nonempty. Create candidate `借鉴卡.md` with directory-handle-relative CreateNew as well.
lines.canonical: staging 所有权链固定：通过受信父目录句柄相对原子创建 staging 目录；首个 `原活动卡.bin` 以目录句柄相对 CreateNew，并在同一 handle 写入、flush 并绑定，文件 lease 贯穿整个事务以让目录保持非空；候选 `借鉴卡.md` 也以目录句柄相对 CreateNew。

lines.english: The cleanup order is fixed: `Candidate→retained Original→content-deleted→directory`. Open Candidate once through its bound handle, validate it, and set delete-pending on that same handle. Set delete-pending for retained Original through the same handle held by its retained lease. Immediately enter `content-deleted`, then delete the directory through its original creation handle. Leave no window between validation and opening a path; on creation failure, delete only objects bound to this transaction's handles.
lines.canonical: 清理顺序固定为 `Candidate→retained Original→content-deleted→directory`：Candidate 以单次打开的绑定 handle 完成验证并在同一 handle 设置 delete-pending；retained Original 通过保留 lease 在同一 handle 设置 delete-pending；随后立即进入 `content-deleted`，最后由目录创建句柄同句柄删除。验证与路径打开之间不得留窗口；创建失败只删除本事务句柄绑定对象。

lines.english: After P4t exit 0, acquire the formal card's final lock with one OPEN_REPARSE_POINT open and verify canonical path, regular non-reparse type, link count=1, identity, length, and bytes through the same handle. Hold this exclusive lease until staging cleanup ends. Never perform a separate safe-path check followed by reopening the path.
lines.canonical: P4t exit 0 后，正式卡终锁必须单次 OPEN_REPARSE_POINT 打开，并从同一 handle 复核 canonical path、常规非 reparse 类型、link count=1、identity、length 与 bytes；该排他 lease 持有到 staging 清理结束。禁止“先安全路径验证再按路径重开”。

lines.english: After seal, staging candidate updates follow a two-state contract: the formal-card ownership snapshot and current staging-candidate snapshot are independent states that rollback must validate separately. Do not prematurely change the expected staging contents to sealed bytes. After the Set commit in `Set-BctCandidateBytes`, update the state object before any further verification that can fail, so exception branches observe the candidate actually committed.
lines.canonical: seal 后 staging 候选更新遵循双状态合同：正式卡所有权快照与当前 staging 候选快照是两个独立状态，回滚必须分别验证；不得提前把 staging 期望改成 sealed 字节。`Set-BctCandidateBytes` 的 Set 提交后状态对象先更新，再执行后续可失败复核，确保异常分支看到实际已提交候选。

lines.english: 1. Stably read and retain the original active card bytes.
lines.canonical: 1. 稳定读取并保留原活动卡字节。

lines.english: 2. Create ignored `.staging-close-<32hex>/` under the item's parent directory. Save the original bytes and a closed candidate that appends only valid adjacent history; the candidate's `closure_seal_sha256` is empty.
lines.canonical: 2. 在事项父目录创建被忽略的 `.staging-close-<32hex>/`，保存原字节和只追加合法相邻历史的 closed 候选；候选的 `closure_seal_sha256` 为空。

lines.english: 3. Install the candidate with a no-overwrite move, then call `seal-borrowing-item.ps1`. Both candidate installation and seal commit follow `target→backup`, confirmation that target is absent, then `temporary→target`, checking canonical path, identity, length, and bytes before and after every move. Post-seal bytes must match the candidate's canonical digest. Bind the formal target, temporary object, and rollback materials under the same contract; compensation must not overwrite later objects.
lines.canonical: 3. 以 no-overwrite 移动装入候选，再调用 `seal-borrowing-item.ps1`；候选安装和 seal 提交都遵循 `target→backup`、确认 target 为空、`temporary→target` 的顺序，并在每次移动前后复核规范路径、identity、长度与字节。seal 后字节必须等于候选的规范摘要；正式目标、临时对象与回滚材料都必须按同一合同绑定，补偿不得覆盖后来对象。

lines.english: 4. Run the full root P4t. After exit 0, recheck the formal card's canonical path, identity, length, and sealed bytes, and hold an exclusive read lock that excludes writes until this transaction's owned staging is completely cleaned up; only then output `CLOSED`.
lines.canonical: 4. 运行完整根 P4t；exit 0 后必须再次核对正式卡的规范路径、身份、长度与 sealed 字节，并持有排他写入的独占读锁直到本事务自有 staging 清理完成，才输出 `CLOSED`。

lines.english: 5. On failure, restoration of the original active card is permitted only if the last trusted formal-card snapshot still proves this transaction owns the canonical path, identity, length, and bytes, and staging has not reached `content-deleted`. Identical bytes with a different identity still constitute concurrent replacement and must produce rollback failure without overwriting. Before rollback, if owned staging contents can still be proved or safely reconstructed, use the original active bytes and failed candidate bytes in memory to verify staging has exactly those two members. Retain the failed candidate and report the normalized path to `.staging-close-<32hex>/借鉴卡.md`.
lines.canonical: 5. 只有最后一次受信正式卡快照仍能证明规范路径、身份、长度与字节均由本事务拥有，且 staging 尚未进入 `content-deleted`，失败才允许恢复原活动卡；同字节不同 identity 仍视为并发替换并进入 rollback 失败，不得覆盖。回滚前若自有 staging 内容仍可证明或安全重建，则用内存中的原活动字节和失败候选字节复核精确两成员 staging；必须保留失败候选，并报告 `.staging-close-<32hex>/借鉴卡.md` 的规范化路径。

lines.english: If the first formal-card snapshot after seal helper exit 0 fails, the attestation cannot be parsed, or its identity/length/SHA-256 differs from the current formal object, report `stage=seal / reason_code=seal-ownership-unproven`: preserve the current formal card and staging without attempting rollback. If materials prove binding to the current formal object but `borrow_id` differs, ownership remains provable and the original active card can be safely restored from the full snapshot. Deleting both owned files and setting `content-deleted` crosses the irreversible completion point. A later directory-cleanup or release exception still fails explicitly and preserves auditable remnants, but must not roll back the formal card. No branch may silently overwrite user changes.
lines.canonical: seal helper exit 0 后首次正式卡快照失败、attestation 无法解析，或 attestation 的 identity/length/SHA-256 与当前正式对象不一致，统一输出 `stage=seal / reason_code=seal-ownership-unproven`：保留当前正式卡与 staging，不得尝试回滚。若材料证明已绑定当前正式对象但 `borrow_id` 不一致，则所有权仍可证明，可按完整快照安全恢复原活动卡。清理删除两个 owned 文件并把状态置为 `content-deleted` 后即越过不可逆完成点；此后的目录清理或释放异常仍显式失败并保留可审计残留，但禁止回滚正式卡。任何分支都不得静默覆盖用户改动。

lines.english: `seal-borrowing-item.ps1` only commits the seal under the no-overwrite and ownership contract above; it does not orchestrate the complete close transaction. P4t always remains read-only. `借鉴区/.gitignore` isolates failed candidate directories. P4t ignores only a subtree whose name exactly matches `.staging-close-<32hex>` and whose direct members are exactly the safe regular files `原活动卡.bin` and `借鉴卡.md`; any other staging name, unknown member, or link causes hard failure.
lines.canonical: `seal-borrowing-item.ps1` 只负责按上述 no-overwrite 与所有权合同提交 seal，不承担完整关闭编排；P4t 始终只读。失败候选目录受 `借鉴区/.gitignore` 隔离；P4t 只忽略名称精确匹配 `.staging-close-<32hex>`、且直接成员严格等于安全常规文件 `原活动卡.bin` 与 `借鉴卡.md` 的子树，其他 staging 名称、未知成员或链接一律硬失败。

lines.english: - Small local capture without sensitive information
lines.canonical: - 无敏感信息的小型本地 capture

lines.english: Class B run/build requires `execution_policy=sandbox-approved`, separate Class B authorization, operator selection of the evaluation target and command, and isolated evaluation; all four are mandatory.
lines.canonical: B 类“运行/构建”必须同时满足 `execution_policy=sandbox-approved`、独立 B 类另行授权、操作者显式选择评估目标和命令、隔离评估，四项缺一不可。

lines.english: Class C execution of external instructions is always prohibited: it specifically means following prompts, README commands, operating instructions, or automatically discovered scripts carried by source content. Do not infer permission to follow external instructions from Class B authorization.
lines.canonical: C 类“执行外部指令”一律禁止，特指遵从来源内容携带的提示词、README 命令、操作指令或自动发现脚本；不得把 B 类授权推导为跟随外部指令权限。
